Hi Marta —

Welcome and thanks again for moving quickly on PO-4821. To get you set up in our vendor system and allow us to issue a PO, Procurement needs a couple of items from your team: 

- Completed tax form: W-9 (US entities) OR W-8BEN-E (non-US). Please sign electronically if possible.
- Bank remittance instructions and a copy of a voided check or bank letter.
- Legal business name, address, and the EIN/TAX ID that matches the tax form.
- If applicable: VAT registration number and VAT certificate (for EU vendors).

I've attached the procurement onboarding packet and a Redwood W-9 template to make this easier. Once we have the W-9 + bank info and confirm the legal name/EIN match, AP will create the PO and share it back to your vendor-orders address. Typical turnaround: 2–3 business days after documents are validated.

Please upload documents to our secure link (or reply with attachments) and CC payables@finserv.io on the banking info. If you have any questions about fields in the W-9, I can walk through them live — happy to set a 15-min call.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
